An order was placed.

Emitted once, after the order is persisted and payment is authorised.

Payload

  • object
    • customerId string required
    • lines array
      • items object
        • quantity integer required · ≥ 1
        • sku string required
    • orderId string required
    • total object required → ./money.json
      • amount integer required
        Minor units, e.g. cents.
      • currency string required · pattern: ^[A-Z]{3}$

Examples

minimal

{
  "customerId": "cus_9",
  "orderId": "ord_123",
  "total": {
    "amount": 1999,
    "currency": "EUR"
  }
}
